x: After completing a circle round the starting field the leading positions were held by Belton (Surrey A.C.), Cohen (Ashcombe A.C.), Penny, Cook, Stansbury (Ranelagh), and Wills.

After the runners had gone away for the second time, I thought the prospect of the "Bels" winning a very good one, but some fine running by the Surrey A.C., who had Belton and Newton second and third respectively, backed up by their tail men, secured them first team honours.
We were well placed at the start, and after about a mile and a half Hines, of Surrey, was leading, followed by Belton (Surrey), Thorogood (Mitcham), with about nine of ours in the first thirty.
Stan Belton, of Surrey A.C., soon went into the lead, and although Len Herbert, making his usual slow start, gradually overhauled his field, he could not catch Belton, who won in good style.
